name: Example Smart Electronics
hero: Could an agent approve a serial batch while firmware provenance, component revisions and test witnesses disagree?
action: Recommend quarantine after board-test and firmware-context inconsistency
authority: Test Engineering and Quality approval bound to exact board revision, firmware and serials
nativeEffect: Digital QMS quarantine / test batch state (simulated only)
impact: Shipping unqualified assemblies or conflating a retest request with a verified pass

riskCases.name: Firmware/test mismatch
riskCases.question: Does the installed firmware digest match the authorized test matrix?
riskCases.needed: Signed firmware provenance + immutable test rack result + serial identity

riskCases.name: Serial genealogy mismatch
riskCases.question: Do the board, component and supplier-lot identities correlate?
riskCases.needed: As-built trace graph + revisioned lot records + receiving QMS

riskCases.name: Burn-in failure overridden
riskCases.question: Was a failed test independently resolved before release?
riskCases.needed: Test failure witness + disposition authority + release readback

limitations: No real boards, customers, proprietary firmware or manufacturing lines are represented.
A test rerun request is not a successful retest or approved batch release.
No measured yield, model accuracy or production cost claim is issued.
